name: Palestine (All-Palestine Government, 1948–1964)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and black with a red triangle at the hoist.
history: The flag of the Arab Revolt, with the stripes in the order green, white and black, was adopted on 18 October 1948 by the All-Palestine Government in Gaza and subsequently recognised by the Arab League as the flag of Palestine. When the Palestine Liberation Organization was founded in 1964 it adopted the flag with the black stripe uppermost, the present flag of Palestine.
